notes: The five separate groups are correct and are kept on purpose. Set 40413 is a five-in-one: the booklet builds five independent models and none is ever attached to another. The models are b1-b69 tall robot (booklet pages 3-23), b70-b154 round robot on wheels (24-47), b155-b213 four-legged dog (48-57), b214-b301 rover (58-83) and b302-b366 grabber robot (84-104). Each model is fully connected inside itself, so no join between models is added.

Within each model every piece is connected. Stray pieces were attached earlier: b155 under b159; the second projectile b69 on launcher b51; the spare lenses b300 and b301 on the blasters; the grabber's arm frame (b341-b365) pinned to b316; the red ball b366 held by axle ends b349 and b364. Several of these attachment points are approximate readings of the drawings (the booklet shows b69, b300, b301 and b366 loose or only resting).

Counts per type and colour match the 366-piece parts list. Colours and a few look-alike types (2780 pins vs 32062 axles, 3069b vs 63864 vs 2431 tiles, curved slopes 11477 / 15068 / 37352) were assigned by shape and by the parts-list totals, where the small drawings were ambiguous.

Technic and hinge joins are in other_joins. rests_on is filled only for stud-on-anti-stud contacts. Some contacts inside stacked sub-assemblies are approximate. The rover has two alternative front builds (digger arm b270-b284, binocular head b285-b301), so both are in the graph and both rest on b254.
In the round robot, the head sub-assembly rests on the shoulder collar b152 and the ball b79 sits in the socket b133 (step 35). Body b70 sits on chassis b101 (step 21).
